about: Hand-written to the documented output shape of kaitoeasyapi/twitter-x-data-tweet-scraper-pay-per-result-cheapest (its README's Sample Output, read 2026-11-08). No real run was possible when this was written (no Apify token in the sandbox), so the people, companies and links are invented; the field names and the Twitter date format are the actor's. Each item's `case` says what the filter must do with it (the code never reads `case`).

items.case: kept: a hiring post, company named in the text, apply link behind a t.co link, Cairo
items.text: Northwind Analytics is hiring a Data Engineer in Cairo (hybrid). Python, SQL, Airflow. 2+ yrs. Apply: https://t.co/aaa111

items.case: kept: remote, company after 'at', contact is an email, seniority in the title
items.text: We're hiring! Senior Analytics Engineer (remote, EMEA timezones) at Lumen Data. dbt, Snowflake, 4+ yrs. Send your CV to jobs@lumendata.example #hiring #dataengineering

items.case: kept: an Arabic post (role, Cairo, company after 'شركة', contact is an email)
items.text: مطلوب مهندس بيانات للعمل في القاهرة - شركة نوفا للحلول الرقمية. خبرة سنتين في Python و SQL. للتقديم ارسل السيرة الذاتية على hr@nova-digital.example
